## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

We need to build a complete playable 2D fighting game inspired by Street Fighter 6, featuring PMs (heads of government) of India, China, Russia, Ukraine, USA, South Africa, London (UK), France, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia. Superpowers based on famous memes associated with them. Three locations: desert, snowfield, India.

Need to be careful: political figures. This is a satirical fighting game with memes. That's allowed? It involves real political figures as playable characters in a combat game. Could be considered depicting real people in violence. Hmm. Policy considerations: content depicting real people in violent scenarios - generally not disallowed unless it's promoting harm or targeted harassment? We can make it stylized, cartoonish, with no gore, playful meme-based. Probably fine. Need to avoid defamatory or hateful content. Use caricatured cartoon avatars, no realistic likenesses? We can use stylized vector art with national colors/flags and iconic meme references. Keep it lighthearted, no real-world violence advocacy.

We need to build playable game. Pure HTML/CSS/JS canvas likely simplest and reliable. Maybe use no external deps. Need high quality visuals, animations, sound (WebAudio), menus, character select, 3 stages, AI/2P, touch support, mobile responsive.

Let me plan the game carefully:

"World Leader Fighter 6" — parody. Title: "SUPER POWER 6" or "WORLD WARRIOR 6". Inspired by Street Fighter 6, so "STREET FIGHTER 6"-like UI: bold graffiti, neon, urban. We'll make "POWER CLASH 6" with "WORLD LEADERS". Maybe title "GLOBAL CLASH 6". Characters each with meme superpowers:

- India — Narendra Modi: "Modi Ji" — meme: "Mitron!" / "Chai pe charcha" / "Selfie with Modi". Super: "Mitron Mega Rally" or "56-inch Blast"? Use "MITRON!" chant shockwave. Keep respectful-ish. Maybe super = "CHAI BREAK" healing? But superpower famous meme related: "Modi's 56-inch chest" (a meme), "Mitron" address. Use "MITRON MANIFESTO" beam.
- China — Xi Jinping: famous memes: "Winnie the Pooh" (careful, censored topic). Also "No time to die" meme? Best to use "Belt and Road" or "Made in China" or "Social Credit" meme. Super = "SOCIAL CREDIT +1000" — sends score-boost lightning. That's a widespread meme. Character "The Chairman".
- Russia — Vladimir Putin: meme: "Riding a bear", "Putin on a bear", "shirtless judo". Super = "BEAR CAVALRY" summon bear rush, or "Judo Flip". Good.
- Ukraine — Volodymyr Zelensky: meme: "I need ammo, not a ride" — famous quote. Super = "I NEED AMMO" artillery/airdrop. Also he's a comedian/actor. Good.
- USA — Donald Trump: meme: "You're fired!", "Make America Great Again", "covfefe", "bigly", "Tremendous". Super = "YOU'RE FIRED" or "TREMENDOUS WALL". Current date 2026, Trump is president. Use "THE DONALD" with "YOU'RE FIRED!" projectile and "TREMENDOUS" super. Could also do "covfefe" projectile. Use "COVFEFE CANNON" as special, super "YOU'RE FIRED!".
- South Africa — Cyril Ramaphosa: meme: "Phala Phala sofa cash" (scandal), "load shedding" is a national meme. Super = "LOAD SHEDDING" blackout attack. Special = "Phala Phala Cash Cannon". Good.
- London — Mayor of London Sadiq Khan? The request says "London" as a country/character. The PM of UK would be Keir Starmer. But user says "London". Hmm "PM of India, China, russia, Ukraine, USA, south africa, London, France, pakistan, bangladesh,Indonesia". They conflate country/city. London likely means UK, character probably Boris Johnson (famous meme, former PM) or current PM Keir Starmer. Since "London" and famous memes: Boris Johnson's zip line flag incident, "Partygate", "BoJo". I'd use "Boris of London" as the London rep for the iconic meme "stuck on a zip wire waving flags". However current UK PM is Keir Starmer. The user likely wants UK "London" with a PM. Iconic meme is Boris. To avoid mislabeling, name him "BORIS — The London Mayor of Chaos"? That's factually wrong. Better "LONDON — BORIS" as "Former PM turned zip-line daredevil". The request says PM of London which is inaccurate anyway. We'll use Boris Johnson with zip-line super, labeled "LONDON". Hmm, but could be seen as outdated. Alternatively "SADIQ KHAN" Mayor of London (not PM) with "ULEZ" meme? Less global meme. I'll go with Boris (most meme-famous) and note assumption.

Actually current UK PM in 2026 likely Keir Starmer. But meme power for Starmer? "Free Gear Keir", "Lord Alli glasses". Not as famous. User explicitly says "most famous meme of them related to them", so Boris fits best. Assumption noted.

- France — Emmanuel Macron: meme: "La France insoumise"? Famous meme: "pension reform protests", "Macron and the yellow vests", "c'est quoi ce bordel", "baguette". Super = "BAGUETTE BARRAGE" or "YELLOW VEST UPRISING". Maybe "Macron's baguette" is not really. Use "PENSION REFORM" causes rage meter? Or "NOTRE-DAME REBUILD" shield. Hmm. Meme: "Macron juggling" or "Macron boxing" photos. He posed boxing. Super = "BOXING MACRON" flurry. Better: "ART DE LA GUERRE" with baguette sword. Special = "BAGUETTE BOOMERANG"; Super = "YELLOW VEST STORM" (protesters swarm). Yellow vests tied to him. Good.

Current PM Shehbaz Sharif. Meme: "Shehbaz speed" / "Punjab speed". Also Pakistan meme "load shedding" overlaps South Africa. Use Imran Khan? The user says PM; Imran Khan is former PM. Shehbaz is current. Famous meme "Mian Shehbaz Speed" is strong in Pakistan. Use "SHEHBAZ — Speed" super "SPEED RUN" dash barrage. Good.
- Bangladesh — Sheikh Hasina (PM until Aug 2024, then Yunus chief adviser). Current PM? Probably no PM; interim government Muhammad Yunus. Famous meme: Sheikh Hasina's "Bhashan" or the "Hasina flee" helicopter meme (2024). But depicting her fleeing might be sensitive/political. Bangladesh meme: "Mujib" etc. Hmm. For game, use fictionalized "HASINA" with "Tiger of Bengal" or "Padma Bridge" super. Could be seen as aggressive political commentary. Keep it neutral: "BENGAL TIGER" super "ROAR OF THE DELTA". Use character "HASINA" label? Maybe better use "BANGLADESH — THE TIGER" without naming, but user asked PM. Hmm.

We should be careful with real-person violence depictions. Maybe make it clear this is a "satirical meme fighter" and use caricature names/titles. Still they asked. I think it's acceptable to make a lighthearted game. Keep no blood, cartoon stars.

- Indonesia — Prabowo Subianto (president, not PM). Meme: "Gemoy" (cute/adorable) dance, "Prabowo gemoy" went viral in 2024 election. Great super: "GEMOY DANCE" charm/stun, or "OMBAK" wave. Use "PRABOWO GEMOY" with "GEMOY GROOVE" that stuns. That's a real famous meme.
- China: Xi "Social Credit" is a meme but potentially sensitive; use "CHINA — THE DRAGON" special "Social Credit Beam" with "+1000 SOCIAL CREDIT" popups. It's playful.
- Russia: Putin bear.
- India: Modi "Mitron" and "chai".
- USA: Trump "You're fired" / covfefe.
- Ukraine: Zelensky "I need ammo, not a ride".
- South Africa: Ramaphosa "Load shedding" / "Phala Phala".
- London: Boris "Zip line" and "Partygate"? Use zip-line.
- France: Macron "Baguette" + yellow vests.
- Pakistan: Shehbaz "Speed".
- Bangladesh: Hasina? Maybe "Bangladesh — Bengal Tiger" with "Tiger Roar". Since PM request, use "SHEIKH HASINA" and super "TIGER OF BENGAL". Hmm, 2026 current political situation: Hasina ousted. But "PM" list likely user's own knowledge. I'll use "HASINA" with "PADMA BRIDGE / TIGER". Maybe avoid accuracy and call "BANGLADESH — THE BENGAL TIGER" and note character inspired by its long-serving PM. Fine.

Need 3 stages: desert, snowfield, India. Great visual variety. Desert (maybe "Arabian Dunes" / "Sahara Showdown"), snowfield ("Siberian Squall"), India ("Mumbai Monsoon"/"Delhi Dusk"). Add parallax, particles, crowd.

Gameplay:
- 2D fighter on canvas. Two characters with boxes, health bars, super meter.
- Movement: A/D, jump W, crouch S, block (hold back?), light punch J, heavy punch K, kick L, special U? Need simple intuitive controls.
- Best of 3 rounds, 99 second timer.
- Local 2P and vs CPU. Character select for both P1/P2, stage select.
- Mobile touch controls: joystick or buttons; responsive.
- AI opponent with basic state machine.
- Special moves: quarter-circle? Simpler: single button special with cooldown, super with full meter. For accessibility, use dedicated special button.
- Each character unique stats and superpower effect (projectile, rush, heal, stun, etc.).
- Juice: hitstop, screen shake, particles, damage numbers, combo counter, announcer text, crowd flashes, dust, slow-mo KO, victory pose.
- Audio: WebAudio synthesized hits, whoosh, super, crowd, music loop. Need user gesture to start audio.
- Visuals: Canvas 2D with procedurally drawn characters (stylized big-head caricatures) in suits with country color accents. Need good-looking. Could create character portraits on the select screen with canvas or CSS/SVG.

Maybe implement with a single index.html plus game.js and style.css. Keep it manageable but rich. Need test via playwright screenshot, iterate.

Let's think through character rendering. Draw stacked shapes: legs, torso (suit), arms with fists, head with skin tone, hair, distinct features (beard, glasses, hair color), flag-colored sash/tie. Poses: idle bob, walk, jump, crouch, punch, kick, block, hurt, win, super. Parameterized skeleton with limb positions calculated. We can draw in local coordinates facing direction. Scale ~1.0, height ~170 px at 800x450 logical canvas? Use 1280x720 internal canvas scaled CSS. Fighters ~240px tall.

Camera: fixed side view with slight zoom per round, parallax backgrounds. Floor y ~ 610. Stage width ~ 1280, fighters constrained 120..1160. Screen shake.

Need game loop with fixed timestep. State machine for menu/select/fight/roundend/matchover.

Simplify physics: x, y position at feet; vx, vy; grounded. Hitboxes computed based on attack active frames. Blocking reduces damage; chip for specials maybe.

Controls:
P1: A/D move, W jump, S crouch/block? Common: hold back to block. Use A/D relative to facing: holding away blocks. J light, K heavy, L kick, U special, I super. Too many for mobile. Simplify:
- J = Punch (light)
- K = Kick (heavy)
- L = Special
- I = Super
- Hold S or away = block
Mobile: D-pad left/right/up/down, and 4 buttons: P, K, S, ★.

For AI: approach, attack in range, occasionally jump, block, use special, super.

Each round 60s. First to 2 rounds. Health 1000.

1. India — MODI: "MITRON!" projectile (sound wave), super "CHAI PE CHARCHA" heal + buff? Or "56-INCH WAVE". Let's implement:

Need 11 characters with portraits. Represent with canvas-generated portraits? Could use CSS avatars built from divs. I can generate SVG avatars programmatically for each character with head, hair, suit, flag. That could look cohesive and stylish. Let me think about canvas rendering in detail.

Logical resolution: 1280x720. Stage floor y=600. Fighters scale 1.0, height ~230. x range 100..1180. Camera no scroll (stage fits); zoom punches? We can add camera shake and slight zoom on super.

}
```
`y` = feet y. On ground y=stage.floor; jumping y decreases.

Body drawing with `drawFighter(ctx, fighter, t)`:
- pose object computed from state (idle/walk/jump/crouch/attack/hurt/block/win).

- Character-specific head: face color, hair style, beard, glasses, suit color, flag accents.

  const blocked = target.state==='block' && target.facing === ... (facing toward attacker)

  else { target.blockstun=...; target.vx = ...; }
  particles...
  damage number...
  ...
}
```

function updateProjectiles(dtf) {

   p.life -= dtf;
   p.x += p.vx*dtf;
   p.y += (p.vy||0)*dtf;
   if (p.gravity) p.vy += ...
   if (p.wave) p.y = p.baseY + sin(p.life*0.2)*p.amp;
   if (p.boomerang) { p.vx *= ... after frames; }
   p.rot += ...
   // trail particles
   if (p.life<=0 || out of bounds) remove;
   // collision with opponent
   const target = G.players[1-p.owner];
   if (p.hitCooldown>0) p.hitCooldown -= dtf;
   if (overlap(p, hurtbox(target)) && p.hitCooldown<=0) {
      applyHit(owner, target, p.damage, {kb:p.kb, stun:p.stun, source:'projectile'})
      p.hits--; p.hitCooldown = p.interval||20;

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable fighting game inspired by Street Fighter 6, featuring world leaders as playable characters, meme-inspired superpowers, and three stages.

## Requirements
- Playable characters representing leaders/countries or regions: India, China, Russia, Ukraine, USA, South Africa, London, France, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Indonesia.
- Superpowers should reference their most famous related memes.
- Include desert, snow field, and India locations.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Created “WORLD CLASH 6,” a self-contained canvas fighting game using custom-drawn visuals and WebAudio, with no external game assets.
- Added a roster, CPU and local play flows, character selection, stage selection, touch controls, and keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added font assets under `assets/`.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully during development and exercised title, character selection, stage selection, and fight screens in Playwright.
- Used screenshots to inspect title, selection, stages, and combat visuals.

### Active
- Final polish and validation; the last edits adjusted fighter proportions and added jacket details.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and inspect the latest changes for runtime issues.
2. Run the game through the full selection-to-fight flow and check each of the three stages.
3. Review the intended roster and meme superpowers against the request, then summarize assumptions and validation in the final response.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and screen structure.
- `style.css`: Layout, styling, and responsive/touch presentation.
- `game.js`: Roster, gameplay, rendering, input, and match flow.
- `assets/`: Bundled Lato font files used by the game.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local dev server was started with `PORT=3002 ./start.sh`; Playwright was used to verify screens.
- Temporary screenshots and test script were written under `/tmp/opencode/` and `screenshots/`.

## Objective
- Complete WORLD CLASH 6, a playable fighting game inspired by Street Fighter 6, featuring world leaders, meme-inspired powers, and three stages.

## Requirements
- Include India, China, Russia, Ukraine, USA, South Africa, London, France, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Indonesia as playable characters.
- Include desert, snow-field, and India locations.
- Build a complete playable game without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained canvas game with custom-drawn visuals and WebAudio, avoiding external game assets.
- Included CPU and local play, character and stage selection, touch and keyboard controls, and responsive presentation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`; bundled Lato fonts under `assets/`.
- Added the full 11-character roster and three stages.
- Tested desktop, portrait, and landscape selection-to-fight flows, touch SUPER, pause/resume, results, and combat hits; completed runs reported no browser errors.
- Tightened mobile landscape roster spacing; verified the roster fits at tested landscape sizes including 568×320.

### Active
- Finish validation: the last end-to-end pass timed out during the small-landscape run, and desktop roster-fit measurement still showed a 5px overflow (`scrollHeight: 458`, `clientHeight: 453`).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-run a focused small-landscape end-to-end flow with a longer timeout or fewer screenshots.
2. Check whether the desktop roster’s 5px overflow is material; adjust only if necessary.
3. Run `node --check game.js` and inspect `git status --short` before reporting completion.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and touch controls.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Roster, powers, gameplay, rendering, input, and match flow.
- `assets/`: Bundled Lato font files.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Dev server was available at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The last validation script was `/tmp/opencode/final3.mjs`; it passed desktop, portrait, and 844×390 landscape checks, then timed out before finishing 568×320.
